methods: Verified every manifest SHA-256 value before classification
Extracted embedded text from every PDF page and applied OCR to every scan-required page

Inspected the complete spreadsheet structure and all 11 worksheets in A12

Applied evidence relevance and material-new-information review independently from duplicate detection
